_notes: Cycle IV terrain tile cards (scanned). Irem Tower/City are used by the Midascore battle; others are stored for future Primordials.

Irem Tower.text: To climb the Irem Tower (if you are not on an Elevated space), test Fury (4+).

Irem City.text: To climb the Irem City (if you are not on an Elevated space), test Fury (5+).

Staircase Entrance.text: To climb the Staircase Entrance (if you are not on an Elevated space), test Fury (4+).

Wishstorm.text: To climb the Wishstorm (if you are not on an Elevated space), test Fury (7+). Treasure: Once per Battle, when adjacent to or on this tile, search it. Roll a d10: 1: Wish Curse: The unpredictable forces of the storm rouse an ancient greed inside you. Gain the Wishagog Condition card. 2-5: Ill-considered Wish! Gain +1 FATE and Wish Away 12! 6-9: Thoughtful Wish: Gain 1 Echo of Recollection Divine resource or gain 1 Golden Bough Rare resource. 10: Wishbreaker Wish: Lose a Curse Affliction or gain 1 Sisyphus Tear, or gain +1 [?], or the Debtguard card! Trap: If a Titan ends their involuntary movement on this tile, they draw an Obol. If the Primordial ends their involuntary movement on this tile, place 1 negative [AT] token in the Kratos Pool.

Argo Hull.text: Hull Damage: If the Primordial moves onto this tile or a Titan would be involuntarily moved onto it, roll a d10. On a 6+, the plating holds. Otherwise, lose -1 [Hull] and disable the Argo Support effect (only once per Battle). Argo Support: Titans within 3 spaces of this tile gain +1 Precision, Power Re-roll 1, Auto-break 1.

Ambrosia Cloud.text: Cloud (This tile is unaffected by other Elevated tiles—it does not lose the Obscuring or Obstacle keywords).

Abandoned Temple.text: Treasure: Once per Battle, when adjacent, search the Abandoned Temple. Roll a d10: 1: Gain the Mazetouched Affliction. 2-5: The Primordial performs Signature against you. 6-9: Gain +1 Priest. 10: Gain 1 Sysiphus Tear (once per Cycle); if already gained from this tile, lose -2 Tides of Fate.

Black Abyss.text: Abyss: You cannot voluntarily move through or ignore this tile in any way; you cannot measure effective range of your weapons through empty spaces of this tile. If a Black Abyss tile moves onto you or you're moved involuntarily through or onto it, you are devoured (die).

Ruined Arcology.text: Allied: Titans on this tile have +1 Light-range. Light 1. Omnilight: This tile projects Light in all cardinal directions. Aligned With Nemesis: Treat this tile as an Obstacle.

Lightwall.text: Light 1. Monument to Progress: For the purposes of Despair adjacency, treat this tile as a Titan. Omnilight: This tile projects Light in all cardinal directions.

Trireme Graveyard.text: Treasure: Once per Battle, when adjacent, search the Trireme Graveyard. Roll a d10 (you may voluntarily choose a lower result): 1: Gain 1 Despair token and 1 Ambrosia token. 2-4: Gain 5 Orichalcum Chunk resources. 5-7: Flip 1 Aether token. 8-9: Gain 1 Undead Silver Rare resource. 10: Gain the Hunter Killer card (Secret deck 18, card 296).

School of Creatures.text: Mobile: If you start your movement on this tile, or move through it during a movement, you may move this tile up 2 spaces in the direction of your movement. Camouflage: When you are on this tile, pass the Priority Target token to the next eligible holder. You cannot be a Target if there are other eligible Targets for the targeting line.

Arcology.text: Allied: Titans on this tile have +1 Light-range. Light 1. Omnilight: This tile projects Light in all cardinal directions. Aligned With Nemesis: Treat this tile as an Obstacle.

Inkblot.text: Cloud (this tile is unaffected by other Elevated tiles).

Petrified Vent.text: Black Smoke (if you suffer Crash on this tile, additionally gain 1 Ambrosia token).

Trench.text: Light Void (spaces of this tile are never considered to be in the range of light; if you occupy any space of such a tile, you cannot check your range of light).

Windblighted Fleet.text: Allied: Titans on this tile have +1 Light-range. Friendly: Titans on this tile have Auto-break 1. Denounced: When you move onto this tile, gain +1 DANGER and +1 FATE. At War: Treat this tile as an Obstacle.
